Northern Sotho: Ka maswabi, dikiletšo tša mesepelo tšeo di bego di ikemišeditše go fokotša go phatlalala ga Covid-19 di ile tša mpefatša go hlaelela ga dithibelapelego ka dinbageng tše di hlabologago.
Amharic: እንደ አለመታደል ሆኖ የኮቪድ-19 ስርጭትን ለመቀነስ ያለሙት የእንቅስቃሴ እገዳዎች በታዳጊ ሃገራት ያለውን የወሊድ መከላከያዎች እጥረት አባብሰዋል፡፡

Source: In this study, the researchers specifically looked at access to condoms among South Africans during the 2019 Covid-19 disease outbreak.
Luganda: Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza baatunuulira obusobozi bw’okufuna obupiira mu bannansi b’eggwanga lya South Afirika mu kiseera endwadde ya Covid-19 we yabalukirawo mu mwaka gwa 2019.
Yoruba: Nínú iṣẹ́ ìwádìí yìí, àwọn aṣèwádìí kanlẹ̀ wo àǹfààní sí rọ́bà ìdáàbòbò láàárín àwọn ènìyàn orílẹ̀-èdè South Africa lásíkò ìbẹ́sílẹ̀ ààrùn Covid-19 lọ́dún 2019.
Zulu: Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi babheke ngqo ukutholakala kwamajazi omkhwenyana kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika ngesikhathi sokuqubuka kwesifo se-Covid-19 ngowezi-2019.
Hausa: A cikin wannan binciken, masu binciken sun yi la’akari da damar samun kwaroron roba a tsakanin’'yan Afirka ta Kudu a lokacin ɓarkewar cutar Covid-19 na shekarar 2019.
Northern Sotho: Ka mo dinyakišišong tše, banyakišiši ba ile ba tloga ba lebelela phihlelelo ya dikhontomo gareng ga MaAfrika Borwa ka nakong ya go phulega ga bolwetši bja Covid-19 ka 2019.
Amharic: በዚህ ጥናት ተመራማሪዎቹ በ2019 የኮቪድ-19 በሽታ ወረርሽኝ ወቅት በደቡብ አፍሪካውያን መካከል የኮንዶም ተደራሽነትን ለይተው አይተዋል፡፡

Source: The researchers used data that was collected during the first national Covid-19 survey in South Africa.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baakozesa obubaka obwakuŋŋaanyizibwa mu kunoonyereza okwekuusa ku Covid-19 okwasooka okukolebwa mu ggwanga lya South Afirika.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí lo dátà tí a gbà lásìkò ìtọpinpin Covid-19 àkọ́kọ́ lorílẹ̀-èdè South African.
Zulu: Abacwaningi basebenzise imininingwane eyaqoqwa ngesikhathi kwenziwa ucwaningo lokuqala lukazwelonke lwe-Covid-19 eNingizimu Afrika.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun yi amfani da bayanan da aka tattara a yayin binciken cutar Covid-19 na farko na ƙasa a Afirka ta Kudu.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba šomišitše tshedimošo yeo e kgobokeditšwego ka nakong ya dinyakišišo tša mathomo tša bosetšhaba ka ga Covid-19 ka Afrika Borwa.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በደቡብ አፍሪካ በተደረገው የመጀመሪያው ብሄራዊ የኮቪድ-19 የዳሰሳ ጥናት ወቅት የተሰበሰበ መረጃን ተጠቅመዋል፡፡

Source: They extracted information such as age and gender, income, access to condoms and where people got condoms.
Luganda: Baafunamu obubaka gamba ng’emyaka n’ekikula, ennyingiza, obusobozi bw’okufuna obupiira awamu n’ebifo abantu mwe baafunanga obupiira.
Yoruba: Wọ́n fa àwọn àlàyé jáde bí ọjọ́-orí, ẹ̀yà-ìbí, owó tí ó ń wọlé, àǹfààní sí rọ́bà ìdáàbòbò, ibi tí àwọn ènìyàn ti rí rọ́bà ìdáàbòbò gbà.
Zulu: Bakhiphe ulwazi olufana neminyaka nobulili, imali engenayo, ukutholakala kwamajazi omkhwenyana nokuthi abantu bawathole kuphi amajazi omkhwenyana.
Hausa: Sun fitar da bayanai kamar shekaru da jinsi da samun kudin shiga da samun kwaroron roba da kuma inda mutane suka samu kwaroron roba.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba ntšha tshedimošo ya go swana le menwgaga le bong, phihlelelo ya dikhontomo le fao batho ba hweditšego dikhontomo gona.
Amharic: እንደ እድሜ፣ ጾታ ፣ገቢ የኮንዶም ተደራሽነት እና ህዝቡ ኮንዶምን ከየት እንደሚያገኝ የመሳሰሉ መረጃዎችን ለይተው አውጥተዋል፡፡

Source: They found that about 1 in 5 South Africans could not access condoms during the 21-day national lockdown that started on 23 March 2021.
Luganda: Baazuula nga kumpi munnansi wa South Afirika 1 ku 5 teyasobolanga kufuna bupiira mu kiseera eky’ennaku 21 eky’omuggalo mu ggwanga lyonna ogwatandika nga 23 Ogwokusatu 2021.
Yoruba: Wọ́n rí i pé ó fẹ́ẹ̀ẹ́ tó ìdá ènìyàn 1 nínú 5 ni wọn kò ní àǹfààní sí rọ́bà ìdáàbòbò ní àsìkò ìsémọ́lé ọlọ́jọ́ 21 ní orílẹ̀-èdè tí ó bẹ̀rẹ̀ ní ọjọ́ 23, oṣù Ẹrẹ́nà ọdún 2021.
Zulu: Bathole ukuthi cishe o-1 kwaba-5 baseNingizimu Afrika akakwazanga ukuthola amajazi omkhwenyana ngesikhathi somvalelandlini kwezwe izinsuku ezingama-21 okwaqala ngomhla zingama-23 kuNdasa wezi-2021.
Hausa: Sun gano cewa kusan 1 cikin 5 ‘yan Afirka ta Kudu ba za su iya samun kwaroron roba ba yayin kulle-kullen ƙasa na kwanaki 21 wanda ya fara a ranar 23 ga watan Maris na shekarar 2021.
Northern Sotho: Ba hweditše gore palo ye e ka bago MoAfrika Borwa o 1 go ba 5 o be a palelwa ke go fihlelela dikhontomo ka nakong ya matšatši a 21 a kiletšo ya mesepelo yeo e thomilego ka la 23 Matšhe 2021.
Amharic: ማርች 23፣ 2021 በጀመረው የ21 ቀናት ብሄራዊ የእንቅስቃሴ እገዳ ከ5 ደቡብ አፍሪካውያን መካከል 1ሰው ኮንዶም ማግኘት እንደማይችል ደርሰውበታል፡፡

Source: The researchers said that Whites, Indians and Asians, and respondents with more income, had more access to condoms compared to black people and the poor.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti Abazungu, Abayindi n’abo abava ku lukalu lwa Asia, awamu n’abeetabi abalina ennyingiza ewerako, baalina obusobozi bw’okufuna obupiira bwa wagguluko bw’ogeraageranya n’Abaddugavu ssaako abaavu.
Yoruba: Àwọn Aṣèwádìí sọ pé àwọn Aláwọ̀ funfun, àwọn India àti Àwọn Asia, àti àwọn olùfọ̀rọ̀wálẹ́nuwò tí ó pa owó tí ó pọ wọlé, ní àǹfààní sí rọ́bà ìdáàbòbò ju àwọn ènìyàn dúdú àti àwọn tálákà lọ.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathi Abamhlophe, amaNdiya kanye nama-Asia, kanye nabaphendulile abanemali eningi, babekwazi ukuthola amajazi omkhwenyana uma kuqhathaniswa nabantu abamnyama nabampofu.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce Fararen fata da Indiyawa da kuma ‘yan Asiya, da masu amsawa da ke da ƙarin kuɗin shiga, sun fi samun damar amfani da kwaroron roba idan aka kwatanta su da baƙaƙen fata da matalauta.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše gore Batjobašweu, MaIndia le MaEšia, le baarabi bao ba bego ba na le letseno le lentši, ba bile le phihlelelo ye ntši ya dikhontomo ge go bapetšwa le bathobaso le bahloki.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ እንደገለጹት ነጮች፣ ህንዶች፣ እስያውያን እና ብዙ ገቢ ያላቸው ምላሽ ሰጪዎች ከጥቁር ህዝቦች እና ድሆች ጋር ሲነጻጸሩ በበለጠ ደረጃ ኮንዶም ማግኘት ችለዋል፡፡

Source: They also found that residents of Kwa-Zulu Natal and Mpumalanga areas were more likely to have access to condoms.
Luganda: Mu ngeri endala era baazuula ng’abatuuze mu bitundu bya Kwa-Zulu Natal ne Mpumalanga baalina emikisa gya wagguluko okufuna obupiira.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún ṣàwárí pé àwọn olùgbé agbègbè Kwa-Zulu Natal àti Mpumalanga fẹ́rẹ̀ẹ́ máa ní àǹfààní sí rọ́bà ìdáàbòbò.
Zulu: Baphinde bathola ukuthi izakhamizi zaKwaZulu-Natal naseMpumalanga zisemathubeni amaningi okuthi zithole amajazi omkhwenyana.
Hausa: Haka nan sun kuma gano cewa mazauna yankunan Kwa-Zulu Natal da kuma Mpumalanga sun fi damar samun kwaroron roba.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba utilla gape gore badudi ba Kwa-Zulu Natal le ba ka mafelong a Mpumalanga ba be ba na le kgonagalo ye ntši yab go fihlelela dikhontomo.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም የኩዋ-ዙሉ ናታል እና የምፑማላንጋ አካባቢዎች ኮንዶም የማግኘት እድላቸው ከፍተኛ እንደሆነ ደርሰውበታል፡፡

Source: The researchers said that 70% of respondents preferred public sources of condoms, like public hospitals and clinics.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti abeetabi abakola ebitundu 70% beeyuniranga ebifo by’olukale omufunibwa obupiira, gamba ng’amalwaliro ga gavumenti awamu n’obulwaliro.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà sọ pé 70% àwọn olùfọ̀rọ̀wálẹ́nuwò ni wọ́n fẹ́ àwọn ibi ìpèsè rọ́bà ìdáàbòbò ti gbogbogbò, bíi ilé ìwòsàn àti ilé ìtọ́jú gbogbogbò.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathi ama-70% abaphenduli bancamela imithombo yomphakathi yamajazi omkhwenyana, njengezibhedlela zikahulumeni nemitholampilo.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce kashi 70% na masu amsawa sun gwammace da hanyoyin samar da kwaroron roba, kamar asibitocin gwamnati da kuma ƙananan asibitoci.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba ba boletše gore 70% ya baarabi e be e rata methopo ya dikhontomo tša phatlalatša, ya go swana le dipetlele tša mmušo le diklinikings.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ እንደተናገሩት 70% ያህል ምላሽ ሰጪዎች እንደ ህዝብ ሆስፒታሎች እና ክሊኒኮች ያሉ የህዝብ ኮንዶም ምንጮችን ይመርጣሉ፡፡

Source: Their results also showed that respondents aged 25-34, and those with at least secondary education, were less likely to prefer public condoms.
Luganda: Bye baazuula era byalaga nti abeetabi abali wakati w’emyaka 25-34, n’abo waakiri abalina obuyigirize bwa sekendule, tekyalinga kyangu kweyunira bupiira obubeera mu bifo eby’olukale.
Yoruba: Àwọn Ààbọ̀ wọn tún fi hàn pé àwọn olùfọ̀rọ̀wálẹ́nuwò láàárín ọjọ́-orí 25 – 34, àti àwọn tí wọ́n ní ó kéré tán ìmọ̀ ẹkọ́ ilé ìwé girama, kò fẹ́rẹ̀ẹ́ fé rọ́bà ìdáàbòbò ti gbogbogbò.
Zulu: Imiphumela yabo iphinde yakhombisa ukuthi abaphenduli abaneminyaka engama-25-34, kanye nalabo okungenani abanemfundo yamabanga aphezulu, mancane amathuba okuthi bakhethe amajazi omkhwenyana omphakathi.
Hausa: Sakamakonsu ya kuma nuna cewa masu amsawa masu shekaru 25-34, da waɗanda suke da aƙalla karatun sakandare, ba su da yiwuwar fifita kwaroron roba na hukuma.
Northern Sotho: Dipoelo tša bona di laeditše gore baarabi ba mengwaga ye 25-34, le bao ba nago le thuto ya sekolo seo se phagamego ya fasana, go be go na le kgonagalo ye nnyane ya gore ba ka rata dikhontomo tša phatlalatša.
Amharic: ውጤታቸውም እንደሚያሳየው እድሜያቸው ከ25-34 የሚሆኑ እና ቢያንስ የሁለተኛ ደረጃ ትምህርት ያላቸው ምላሽ ሰጪዎች ህዝባዊ ኮንዶሞችን የመምረጥ አዝማሚያቸው አነስተኛ ነበር፡፡

Source: Public condoms were preferred by those who had less income, were aged 15-24, or those with no education.
Luganda: Obupiira obubeera mu bifo eby’olukale bweyunirwanga abo abaalina ennyingiza entono, abaalina emyaka egiri wakati wa 15-24, oba abo abataalina buyigirize.
Yoruba: Àwọn rọ́bà ìdáàbòbò ti gbogbogbò jẹ́ fífẹ́ràn lápá ọ̀dọ̀ àwọn tí iye owó tí wọn ń pa wọlé kéré, tí wọn wà láàárín 15 – 24, tàbí àwọn tí wọn kò ní ẹ̀kọ́ ìwé.
Zulu: Amajazi omkhwenyana omphakathi ayekhethwa yilabo ababehola kancane, abaneminyaka eli-15-24 ubudala, noma labo abangafundile.
Hausa: Waɗanda suke da ƙarancin kuɗin shiga, masu shekaru 15-24, ko waɗanda ba su da ilimi sun fi son kwaroron roba na hukuma.
Northern Sotho: Dikhontomo tša phatlalatša di be di ratwa ke bao ba hwetšago letseno la fase, gomme bona ba be ba na le mengwaga ye 15-24, goba bao ba hlokago thuto.
Amharic: ህዝባዊ ኮንዶም የሚመረጠው አነስተኛ ገቢ ባላቸው፣ ከ15-24 አመት እድሜ በሆናቸው ወይም ምንም ትምህርት በሌላቸው ሰዎች ነው፡፡

Source: Whites, Indians and Asians were also less likely to prefer public condoms.
Luganda: Abazungu, Abayindi n’abo abava ku lukalu lwa Asia nabo tekyali kyangu kweyunira bupiira obubeera mu bifo eby’olukale.
Yoruba: Àwọn Aláwọ̀ funfun, àwọn India àti Àwọn Asia bákan náà kò fẹ́rẹ̀ẹ́ fẹ́ rọ́bà ìdáàbòbò ti gbogbogbò.
Zulu: Abamhlophe, amaNdiya kanye nama-Asia nawo ayemancane amathuba okuthi bakhethe amajazi omkhwenyana omphakathi.
Hausa: Fararen fata da Indiyawa da ‘yan Asiya kuma ba su fi son kwaroron roba na hukuma ba.
Northern Sotho: Bathobašweu, MaIndia le MaEšia le bona go be go na le kgonagalo ye nnyane ya gore ba ka rata dikhontomo tša phatlalatša.
Amharic: ነጮች፣ ህንዶች እና እስያውያን የህዝብ ኮንዶም የመምረጥ አዝማሚያቸው አነስተኛ ነበር፡፡

Source: Even though other studies had reported on how limited access to condoms could lead to poor sexual and reproductive health among communities, this was the first study to look specifically at this problem during a disease outbreak in South Africa.
Luganda: Newankubadde ng’okunoonyereza okulala kwali kwolese engeri obukalubo bw’okufuna obupiira gye buyinza okwonoona okwegatta n’okuzaala mu bantu mu bitundu, kuno kwe kunoonyereza okusoose okutunuulira ekizibu kino mu kiseera endwadde we yabalukirawo mu ggwanga lya South Afirika.
Yoruba: Bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé àwọn iṣẹ́ ìwádìí mìíràn ti jábọ̀ lórí bí ìgékúrú àǹfààní sí rọ́bà ìdáàbòbò ṣe lè yọrí sí àlááfíà ìbálòpọ̀ àti ìbísí tí ó mẹ́hẹ láàárín àwọn àwùjọ, èyí ni iṣẹ́ ìwádìí àkọ́kọ́ tí ó kanlẹ̀ wo ìṣòro yìí lásìkò ìbẹ́sílẹ̀ ààrùn kan lórílẹ̀-èdè South Africa.
Zulu: Yize noma olunye ucwaningo lwalubike ukuthi ukufinyelela okulinganiselwe kwamajazi omkhwenyana kungaholela kanjani ebudedengwini bezempilo yezocansi kanye nokuzala emiphakathini, lolu bekuwucwaningo lokuqala ukubheka le nkinga ikakhulukazi ngesikhathi kubheduka isifo eNingizimu Afrika.

Northern Sotho: Le ge e le gore dinyakišišo tše dingwe di ile tša bega mabapi le ka fao phihlelelo ye nnyane ya dikhontomo e ka feletšago ka maphelo ao a fokolago a tša thobalano le tša pelego gareng ga ditšhaba, tše e bile dinyakišišo tša mathomo tša go lebelela kudu bothata bjo ka nakong ya go phulega ga bolwetši ka Afrika Borwa.
